monitored_text: Home Newsroom 2026 June Holiday Schedule 2026 June Holiday Schedule Press Release Jun 13, 2026 Table of Contents Production & Delivery Notes: JLCCNC Factories Holiday Schedule Logistics Companies Schedule Customer Support Schedule [ June 13, 2026 ] – JLCCNC today released its June holiday schedule. Please be informed that due to the holiday, JLCCNC will adjust its operation and production schedules from June 19th to June 21st, 2026 . While our online platform remains fully operational, factory production capacities and shipping schedules will be partially affected during this period. Production & Delivery Notes: ● Ordering: Normal. You can place quotes and orders at any time as usual. ● Production: Suspended. Factory production lines will be paused on June 19th for most factories. The CNC factory will be paused on June 19th and June 21st . ● Shipping: Delayed. Regular dispatch will be suspended during the holiday and will resume progressively on June 22nd, 2026 . ● Lead Time: Postponed. The estimated lead time for all orders affected by the holiday will be extended by 1-3 days accordingly. JLCCNC Factories Holiday Schedule Logistics Companies Schedule Note：No impact on the In-stock Parts Service; in-stock parts are added to your library immediately after checkout. Customer Support Schedule Email and Livechat support will remain available on June 19th and June 20th, and will be suspended on June 21st. Warm Tip: To avoid any project delays caused by the holiday production pause and potential logistics bottlenecks, we highly recommend planning your schedule ahead and placing orders early. Thank you for your understanding and continuous support!
